title: Logic Puzzle Solver in Prolog
description: Encodes classic grid logic puzzles, such as who-owns-which-pet clue sets, as Prolog facts and constraints, then lets the program find the unique solution. Learners see how declarative rules replace step-by-step search code.

title: Kinship and Genealogy Reasoner in Prolog
description: Stores a small family tree as facts and defines rules for cousin, great-uncle and in-law relations, then answers relationship questions in both directions. The challenge is writing recursive rules that terminate on cyclic or incomplete data.

title: Nonogram Puzzle Solver with Constraint Propagation
description: Solves picture-grid puzzles from row and column clues by propagating line constraints until no more cells can be deduced, then backtracking only when stuck. Reports how often propagation alone finishes a puzzle.

title: Evolving an Image from Polygons with a Genetic Algorithm
description: Approximates a target picture by evolving a few hundred translucent polygons through mutation and selection, drawing every generation in the browser. Shows how fitness definition and mutation size change whether the image converges or stalls.

title: Wumpus World Logical Agent
description: Builds an agent that explores a cave grid, records breezes and stenches as propositional facts and infers which squares are safe before stepping. Compares its behaviour with a random explorer over many generated caves.

title: Twenty Questions Game that Learns Its Questions
description: Plays the guessing game by choosing, at each step, the yes or no question that best splits the remaining candidates, and adds a new question when it fails. Demonstrates information gain on a tiny knowledge base.

title: Mastermind Solver with Minimax over the Guess Space
description: Chooses each code guess to minimise the worst-case number of remaining possibilities, and reports the average and maximum number of guesses needed across every possible secret.

title: Propositional Theorem Prover Using Resolution
description: Converts formulas to clause form and decides satisfiability by resolution, with unit propagation and subsumption to keep the clause set small, and prints a human-readable proof when the formula is unsatisfiable.

title: Rule Learner for Tabular Data with Weka
description: Induces ordered if-then rules from a labelled table with a sequential covering algorithm, and compares rule length, coverage and accuracy with a decision tree so a domain expert could read and audit the model.

title: Round-Robin Fixture Generator with Home and Away Constraints
description: Builds a league schedule in which every team plays every other, avoids long runs of home or away games and respects venue clashes, expressed as a constraint model and checked by an independent validator.

title: Adaptive Difficulty Controller for a Platform Game
description: Models a player's skill from deaths and completion times and adjusts enemy speed and gap sizes between levels, with tests showing the controller neither oscillates nor lets a weak player stall.

title: Behaviour Cloning of Human Demonstrations for a Racing Agent
description: Records a person driving a simulated track and trains an agent to imitate the demonstrations, then measures how compounding errors cause drift and how adding corrective recovery data reduces it.
